why: It is auditable and testable for structured comparisons, with no claim that it can infer business judgement or safely submit transactions.

rejected_or_deferred.RPA/UI automation: UI and permissions are unvalidated; high fragility.
rejected_or_deferred.AI agent: not needed for deterministic comparison and adds non-determinism.
rejected_or_deferred.Workflow/orchestration: valuable after source/API ownership and integration design exist.

approval_boundary: Employee reviews all outputs and completes final registration.
